summaries.n-ai-agents: Robinhood Chain coins whose metadata describes AI agents: ZZZ (swarm coordination), PARLEY (social layer), Liege Agents (agent work escrow), Agent Wormhole (agentic finance security), Priors Agents (credit for ERC-8004 agents), Harmonic Agent, Otis Sherwood (an agent running a business) and TANK (agents build a game). Public posts around the HOOD Summit and ERC-8004 agent registries describe the theme; the coins' claims are not verified and no affiliation among them was checked. Measured: eight coins across all their pools.

k-agents.reason: AI agents on Robinhood Chain qualifies: ZZZ, PARLEY and LIEGE here, plus WORM, PRIORS, HARMONIC, OTIS and TANK that the word match missed (8 coins, about $5.6M rolling 24h at discovery, all above the $50K volume and $100K cap bars) and independent public sources (@aiden_network, @8004_scan, HOOD Summit posts). MOONLET, TRENCHES and TRENCH are under the market cap bar; ERRAND is an Orbio mission board. At the six-narrative cap it replaces the weakest narrative, holder rewards in the paired asset (about $3.9M).

k-robinhood.reason: PARLEY and LIEGE join AI-agent coins; DARK (private AI lab), Suited (poker), ORBITAL (audit app), FATHOM (liquidity router) and OFY (neobank) are other Robinhood Chain products without an agent description and are not added.

k-next.reason: Generic word: PEXRA is a pre-launch airdrop coin (Binance/Bybit/OKX listing claims, no product source), CROW is a game coin; LIEGE moves to AI-agent coins.

k-itself.reason: HOOKED (HookedPad transfer-hook launcher, two pools of one coin) and CATGPT (cat "backed by GPT compute") share only a word; posts are shilling.

k-market.reason: Generic word: CATGPT, LUCKY99, THESIS (trading assistant) and ASKR (AI marketplace) share no story.

k-runs.reason: HOOKED (two pools of one coin) and MOONLET (agents built on Orbio, $88K cap, below the member bar) share no story.

k-protocol.reason: Generic word: OCTO (liquidity for tokenized stocks), MASK (ZK privacy coin), PUNCH (local-business tokens) and XMR20 share no story; OCTO is recorded under the deferred tokenized-stocks lead.

k-stocks.reason: Deferred lead: tokenized-stock coins (OTC, ELON, X7, FATHOM, 蝴蝶人生 and OCTO per posts; FUSE and STACK are under the cap bar) total about $8M 24h and the theme is current (a 2026-09-24 post quoting Ansem on a tokenized-stocks thesis), but the mechanisms differ (stock-paired launch tools, fees paid in stock, stock liquidity pools, NFTs) and no single product or official source ties them together. Re-evaluate tomorrow; STONK is a quote asset and is not counted.

k-earn.reason: Generic word: BlackHoles (proposed custodial wallet), DELTA (staking), GP and SEC (hold-to-earn), CROW and STACK share no mechanism.

k-powered.reason: Generic phrase "powered by": COLLECT (Collector Crypt cards), DARK, PUZZLE, MOONLET, HOTBOT (clawpump) and THESIS are unrelated products.

k-wallet.reason: Generic word: MASK (ZEC-quoted ZK privacy coin), BlackHoles (proposed wallet) and ANSEM (wallet-fee coin) share no story.

k-liquidity.reason: OCTO and FATHOM are both tokenized-stock liquidity products and DELTA is a staking pool; folded into the deferred tokenized-stocks lead (k-stocks), not enough alone.

k-deployed.reason: PUTIN and BANDIT only carry a "deployed using j7tracker" attribution line, GP is a hold-to-earn coin; call-group posts only, no product story.

k-future.reason: Generic word: UDR (quarantined implausible-cap pool), e/acc (UsePaid, already in X-handle creator-fee routing), DARK and THESIS share no story.

k-city.reason: Generic word: COLLECT (real-world graded cards), 加密人生 (BSC Chinese-language coin), VSOF (quarantined) and Minecraft share no story.

k-watch.reason: VRAX and Jimothy share a YouTube link in metadata, THESIS is a trading assistant; no common story or source.
